supersedes.rule: Preserve all original biological, input, numerical, statistical and hold clauses except explicitly replaced access/panel/count/accounting clauses below. V1 is the historical reference-available design, not evidence of independent analytical reconstruction.

reason: The original protocol.py and reference_program.py directly compute the required reconstruction. Supplying them permits copying the answer procedure. Reference access is a useful explicit tool-access control, not the independent specification-reconstruction challenge.

scientific_scope.primary_unchanged: Equal-weight MAE of all 240 pooled mouse/area/joint DeltaEV estimates against the same independently executed fixed reference. Negative/null effects valid; no positive-effect reward.
scientific_scope.claims: Analytical implementation/reconstruction under two declared source-access conditions. Not native neural understanding, novel scientific discovery, arbitrary method improvement, biological causality or historical Figure5 reproduction.

common_public_docs.unchanged_original_TASK: Original TASK.md stays immutable in donor history but is not mounted in either successor condition because its blanket method-source availability statement would misdescribe specification-only access. New common prose supplies the same full input/math/metric prescription without executable answer code.
common_public_docs.task_source_status: The original schemas are metadata only; they do not compute predictions. Source provenance in a contract is not retrieval authority; both contexts remain offline.

visible_inputs.one_case_only: Exactly the same admitted original case packet bytes and case metadata for all three producers. No complete catalogue, aligned session, other fold or target mounts. Input/model/cache state is fresh for every case and condition.

program_freeze.order: Separately freeze both global candidate programs, dependency/image selections, public prompt/doc inventories and resource maxima before exposing any case input or starting any producer. Reference source and selected environment are independently frozen.
program_freeze.contexts: Use distinct authoring contexts with no shared conversation, hidden attachment, assistant artifacts, writable cache or memory. Specification-only authoring and execution exclude answer-producing protocol/reference implementations, prior candidate/control/reference predictions and task-specific helpers that expose equivalent executable oracle APIs. Control receives only its additional declared source, not reference outputs.
program_freeze.image_and_cache_review: Exact externally admitted image/module/package/cache/bytecode and helper API inventory must cover every task-specific code path for both authoring and runtime. Generic numerical libraries are allowed in both. Runtime mount whitelist alone does not establish the earlier authoring exposure boundary.
program_freeze.no_feedback: No reference-code-control source, outputs, traces, fitted state or observations flow into the specification-only authoring context; no cross-condition tuning or retries. No reference output goes to either candidate. Both are sealed before any input/run.
program_freeze.comparability: Use the same disclosed generic numerical environment and resource maxima and the same exact inputs, math, schema and scoring. Independently record authoring budgets/settings/context identities and actual spend; source access is the declared treatment. Control has two additional read-only method files.
program_freeze.limits: A review can establish declared artifacts/context isolation, not prove absence of model pretraining or prior knowledge. Both conditions require independent method/exposure admission tied to exact source, documents, images, settings, origin and limits. Do not reuse generic booleans under changed configuration.

panels_and_schedule.fixed_order: All 50 specification-only cases, all 50 reference-code-control cases, then all 50 trusted-reference cases, in original mouse/area/fold order. Both candidate programs must already be frozen before the first phase. No favorable reordering, skip, retry or replacement.
panels_and_schedule.reference_reuse: Compute the complete trusted 50-case panel exactly once. Its source/input/environment/closure/output lineage must join identically to each comparison. Reuse the same authenticated immutable output bytes for both unchanged original grades; never describe this as 100 independent reference executions. Reference execution has no candidate artifacts or outputs.

joint_grading_gate.before_truth: Authenticate all three complete 50-case panels, all 150 natural producer closures, exact source/selection/context/input/output joins and expected NPZ schemas/IDs/finite values before any protected target callback. Both candidate grades are withheld on any missing/failed/unattempted case or reference failure.
joint_grading_gate.protected_read: For each original scorer call, reauthenticate the matching reference body against its previously admitted output pin before that case target is accessed. Retain original candidate reread authentication. Use exact captured score/protocol/common/array_io definitions; NEURAL025 donor helper splits are forbidden.
joint_grading_gate.reuse_and_targets: Run the original scorer twice with the same independently admitted reference panel. Explicitly account for repeated reference/target reads and scoring work. Query truth never reaches authoring or native producer contexts. Protected target loader custody and hard cutoff remain separately qualified.
joint_grading_gate.failure_history: Preserve attempted, failed and unattempted case histories across all panels, including uncertain close/creation/cost states. Shared reference failure invalidates both comparisons. No standalone score from a successful subset of this matched comparison.
joint_grading_gate.matched_report: Report both unchanged primary and secondary results separately. An optional labeled paired descriptive difference (specification-only MAE minus code-control MAE) is not a new primary score, independent sample, binary reward or task count.

resource_revision.basis: S is sum of all ten session matched trials, at most 40960 under original guards. Actual support and representation unobserved; all numeric arithmetic is cumulative component estimates, not allocated/observed spending or resident dataset size. No smaller support is permitted.
resource_revision.input_formula: 588008*S bytes per 50-case panel; three panels 1764024*S. Eight-byte widths are a specified representation illustration, not a universal original dtype maximum. Actual primitive dtypes and complete raw/expanded NPZ sizes govern admission.
resource_revision.candidate_algorithm_work: Unobserved. Exact compliant method would have150..250 ridge fits and100 SVDs per candidate panel,450..750 ridge fits and300 SVDs over three panels. Source admission does not establish actual program optimizer work.
resource_revision.full_costs: Account for preparation/catalogue validation, all150 staging reads/writes, capture and expanded arrays, repeated output parsing/hash/readback, both original scorer calls, target/reference reuse reads, source/context/image capture, native replies, all metadata, retained outputs, failed work and close evidence. Headers/ZIP/descriptors add overhead. Use actual selected whole-run CPU/RAM/disk/IO/deadline maxima plus bounded hard cutoffs; no component formula proves feasibility.

holds: Authentic full ten-source preparation, all50 packets/support/design identities absent/unqualified.
No authenticated numerical environment or portable/MATLAB parity.
No independent reference execution/competence or candidate method review.
No scientific runs, actual scores, contamination guarantee or registration authority.
